title: LoRa L2: synchronize queue stats with queue destruction
description: Round-4 correctness review found lichen_lora_l2_queue_stats_get() can race lichen_lora_l2_deinit()/tx_queue_destroy(). The accessor permits non-UNINIT states and only takes the queue lock, while destroy requires exclusive quiescence; a state-only check has a TOCTOU window. Add lifecycle synchronization covering the public stats accessor and destruction, plus a regression.
notes: 2026-08-29 worker: implementation verified by inspection (lora_l2_tx.c accessor holds lora_mutex across lifecycle switch; lora_l2.c deinit holds lora_mutex across tx_queue_destroy incl. DESTROY_FAILED retry). Host tx_queue suite passes with ASan+UBSan (exit 0). ping_l2 regression (test_queue_stats_accessor_lifecycle) is native_sim-only -> needs AWS builder run before close; labeling needs-linux and releasing.
close_reason: Already implemented + regression exists. Lifecycle sync: lichen_lora_l2_queue_stats_get (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_tx.c:422-462) takes lora_mutex across the full state dispatch (RUNNING/STOPPED read queue; UNINIT -ENODEV; DEINITING -EBUSY; ABORTED/DESTROY_FAILED -ECANCELED), serializing with the destroy section in lichen_lora_l2_deinit (lora_l2.c:439+) — the TOCTOU window against tx_queue_destroy is closed, with rationale comment in place. Regression: test_queue_stats_accessor_lifecycle (lichen/tests/ping_l2/src/main.c:517-549) asserts readable while running/stopped, -ENODEV after destroy, usable after re-init. Landed in checkpoint commit 95d85c3747. Caveat: ztest suite runs under Twister/native_sim (Linux); local execution delegated to the AWS ztest-runner path (see bead y7wh). No files changed this session.
